name: proxy-framebuffer-unbounded-alloc
title: Proxy framebuffer allocates vec![0u8; size] from unbounded device u32 (~4GiB OOM)
description: proxy/device_commands/framebuffer.rs:33-43 (V1) and 63-73 (V2) allocate from a device-controlled u32 size with no MAX_PAYLOAD-style bound (try_into only fails on 32-bit usize). Bound against width*height*4 via checked_mul or a fixed cap. Finding #6.
creator: magicdian
